description: Execution pipeline and data flow guide for the receipt parser using common line types, normalization rules, and store-specific KB (production-ready)
goals: 원본 OCR line을 보존하면서 normalized_line_text를 별도로 생성한다
스토어별 패턴 차이를 공통 line_type 체계로 정규화한다
Parser는 구조 추출까지만 수행하고 의미 해석은 수행하지 않는다
Semantic Interpreter가 사용할 수 있는 안정적인 parser output을 생성한다
item, discount, summary, noise 간 role collision을 parser 단계에서 안정적으로 분리한다

pipeline_flow.name: Input Loading
pipeline_flow.input: Raw OCR Result (List of lines with Bounding Boxes)
action: Load OCR lines in original order
Preserve original line_text
Preserve line_idx
Preserve line-level coordinates or source word coordinates

pipeline_flow.name: Common Normalization
action: Apply common normalization rules from common/normalization_rules.json -> rules
Generate normalized_line_text separately from line_text
Do not overwrite original line_text
Apply whitespace cleanup, number separator normalization, split number join, prefix cleanup, keyword spacing normalization

pipeline_flow.name: Store-Specific Normalization
action: Identify store_id before pattern classification
Apply store-specific normalization overrides from common/normalization_rules.json -> store_overrides[store_id]
Apply keyword aliases from {store}/keyword_aliases.json
Keep both line_text and normalized_line_text

pipeline_flow.name: Input Validity Guards
action: Apply guard rules from {store}/policies.json -> input_validity_policy before final role classification
Prevent lines matched by discount patterns from being downgraded to item roles
Prevent lines matched by summary patterns from being downgraded to item roles
Prevent noise heuristics from swallowing valid item_name or item_detail lines
Ensure single-line item patterns are checked before generic item_name fallback
pipeline_flow.output: Validated candidate lines ready for role classification

pipeline_flow.name: Store Role Classification
pipeline_flow.input: Validated candidate lines ready for role classification
action: Classify each line using store-specific patterns and keywords
Use {store}/item_patterns.json for item_name and item_detail candidates
Use {store}/discount_patterns.json for discount_detail and receipt_discount candidates
Use {store}/summary_patterns.json for subtotal and total candidates
Use {store}/noise_patterns.json for noise candidates
If multiple store-role matches occur, follow store KB priority and choose the most specific role

pipeline_flow.name: Common Line Type Mapping
action: Map store_role to common line_type using {store}/roles_map.json
Final parser output line_type must use only the enum defined in common/line_types.json
If needed, preserve store_role as an auxiliary field
Unknown or unmatched lines must default to line_type=noise
Store roles declared as non_line_roles in {store}/roles_map.json must not be emitted as final common line_type values

pipeline_flow.name: Field Extraction
action: Extract code, qty, unit_price_raw, price_raw, discount_raw, name_raw as applicable
Use only store-specific extraction patterns from {store}/item_patterns.json and {store}/discount_patterns.json
Do not infer semantic relationships between lines
Subtotal and total lines may extract price_raw
Receipt discount lines may extract discount_raw
If field extraction is uncertain, preserve line_type and raw texts while omitting the uncertain field
pipeline_flow.output: Tagged lines with extracted raw fields

pipeline_flow.name: Numeric Casting and Qty Imputation
pipeline_flow.input: Tagged lines with extracted raw fields
action: Apply numeric field casting based on common/normalization_rules.json
Remove commas before integer casting
Handle trailing minus and trailing T markers
Apply qty=1 imputation only when allowed by {store}/policies.json and only after item_detail or discount_detail pattern match is confirmed
Set is_imputed_qty=true when qty is inferred
Do not apply qty imputation to plain text lines, discount_keyword lines, or summary lines

pipeline_flow.name: Final Output Packaging
action: Package metadata including store_id, parser version, and parsed_at
Return all lines including noise lines
Preserve ordering by line_idx
Preserve original line_text and normalized_line_text together
Ensure final line_type values are only from common/line_types.json

classification_priority_policy.description: Recommended priority when a line matches multiple candidate roles
notes: Store-specific priority may override this default when explicitly defined in store policies
A more specific numeric pattern should win over a generic text pattern
Header and tail-section keywords may force noise or summary classification depending on store KB
single-line item_detail patterns must be evaluated before generic item_name fallback

field_rules.rule: Normalized text used for pattern matching
Must be one of common/line_types.json -> line_type_enum
Extract only when pattern match confirms code-like segment
Extract from explicit qty token or impute according to store policy
Integer candidate after normalization and numeric casting
Integer candidate after normalization and numeric casting
Optional numeric candidate for subtotal/count summary lines
true only when qty is not explicitly present and is inferred

coordinate_preservation.policy: Line-level coordinate preservation is required. Character-level mapping is optional unless token-level UI highlighting is required.
coordinate_preservation.purpose: To enable UI highlighting and traceability after normalization

raw_text_preservation.policy: Original line_text must always be preserved
raw_text_preservation.purpose: To avoid loss of semantic hints such as IRC, EXM, PP, [앱], bracket tags, and OCR artifacts

traceability.policy: Every normalized and classified line must remain traceable to its original input line
traceability.purpose: To support debugging, evaluation, and semantic post-processing

error_handling.on_multiple_matches: Follow store_kb priority; if equal, choose the more specific role over generic noise
error_handling.on_field_extraction_failure: Keep line_type if classification is confident, omit uncertain fields, and preserve raw texts

non_common_role_handling.description: Some store-specific roles do not map directly to final common line_type values
rules: If a store role is declared as non_line_roles in roles_map.json, do not emit it as final line_type.
Examples include fee, dedupe_policy, validation, normalization, merge_policy, and code policy roles.
Such roles may be preserved in store_role or handled only at policy/validation layers.

costco: Costco item_detail raw order may be code + qty + unit_price + total_price
Discount lines may appear as discount_keyword, discount_target, and discount_detail blocks
T and -T markers must be normalized before numeric casting
IRC, EXM, PP tags must remain available in raw text for semantic interpretation
emart: Emart item_detail raw order is usually code + unit_price + qty + total_price
Single-line merged item structures are allowed
Most discount_detail lines are position-based and attach to the previous item in semantic stage
Receipt-level discounts such as card/app discounts must not be attached to items in parser stage
Fee-like lines such as 공병 may be preserved as store_role if not supported by common line types
hanaro: Hanaro item_detail raw order is usually code + unit_price + qty + total_price
Code length range is wider and barcode-like patterns are common
Item discount and receipt discount may coexist
Duplicate discount resolution is not handled in parser stage
Bracket tags and discount summary lines may need auxiliary preservation for downstream validation

semantic_interpreter_handoff: The parser MUST NOT group items and discounts.
The parser MUST NOT calculate final balance or final_price.
The parser MUST NOT attach discount_detail to item_detail.
The parser MUST NOT resolve dedupe or receipt-level validation logic.
All lines, including noise lines, should be preserved for traceability and context.
Semantic interpretation should actively process only relevant line types.

implementation_notes: There is no single common_kb.json file. The parser must use common/line_types.json, common/normalization_rules.json, and store-specific KB files together.
Store-specific roles may be more detailed than common line types.
The final parser output must expose only common line_type values, while store_role may be preserved as an auxiliary field.
Parser output should remain stable even when semantic rules change later.
If a common line type does not exist for a store-specific concept, preserve it as store_role rather than force-mapping unsafely.
